Analysisandcountermeasuresofdruginteractionsinthetreatmentofchronicdiseasesinelderlypatients
LIUJing，LIShengwei，WANGDan，ZHANGLing （DepartmentofPharmacy，JiuquanPeople’sHospitalofGansuProvince，GansuJiuquan735000，China）［ABSTRACT］ Objective： Toanalyzepossibledruginteractionsinthetreatmentofchronicdiseasesinelderlypatients，soasto reduceadversedrugreactions（ADRs） andcomplications，andalsotoguiderationaluseofdrugsinclinic．Methods： Caseinfor－ mationof180patientswithcardio－cerebralvasculardiseases，diabetesandchronicrespiratorydiseaseswerescreenedfrom JiuquanPeople’sHospitalofGansuProvincefromJanuary2017toMay2017inaretrospectivestudy．Thedrugutilizationwas summarizedandpotentialdruginteractionswereanalyzed．Results： Inthecomprehensivetreatmentofchronicdiseases， the highestpercentageofdrugcombinationinvolved6－10drugs，accountingfor40％ ，theleastusedcombinationdrugswererelated with2drugs，andthemostfrequentlyusedcombinationdrugswereasmanyas16drugs．Therewere116casesofdruginterac－ tions， withapercentageashighas64．4％ ， ofwhichthehighestpercentageofdruginteractionsinvolved2drugs，accounting for40．0％．8casesofADRswererecordedandreportedinthecourseofdisease．Druginteractionsthatoccurredbetweenclas－ sicalorcommonly－useddrugswerequitefrequent．Conclusion： Inthetreatmentofchronicdiseases， druginteractionsarecom－ monlyseen．Pharmacistsshouldclearlyknowthemechanismandregularityofcommondruginteractions， assistphysiciansto optimizetreatmentprofilesandminimizethekindsofdrugsused， soastoavoidorreduceadversereactionsbetweendrugsand ensuresafeclinicalmedication［KEYWORDS］ chronicdisease； druginteraction； drugcombination； adversedrugreactionreportingsystem［PharmCareRes，2020，20（1） ：41－44］随着老龄化社会的到来慢性病已成为影响人类健康的最主要因素在我国 60％～70％的老年人有慢性病史人均患有2～3种疾病患病率约为53．8％［1］ 为了更好地减少慢性病治疗过程中药物相互作用引起的药品不良反应 （ADRs） 和并发症改善过度用药情况作者对甘肃省酒泉市人民医院慢性病治疗过程中的用药情况进行调研， 对可能发生的药物不良相互作用进行总结以期为慢性病治疗提供参考
